title: Add WebDriver BiDi hooks for pageshow and pagehide
body: Call the WebDriver BiDi page show steps when the pageshow event fires, after a document loads and when a document is reactivated. Call the WebDriver BiDi page hide steps when the pagehide event fires while unloading a document. This lets WebDriver BiDi clients know when a document restored from the back/forward cache is shown. No load event fires in that case. See https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/issues/1019 and https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/1217 This is needed for https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/1217, which adds the `browsingContext.pageShow` and `browsingContext.pageHide` events (w3c/webdriver-bidi#1019). Changes: - "The end": after `pageshow` fires, invoke `WebDriver BiDi page show` with the document's navigation ID and `persisted` false. The step that sets the during-loading navigation ID to null now runs after this call, so the ID is still available. The call is guarded by a null check on the document's node navigable. - "Reactivate a document": after `pageshow` fires, invoke `WebDriver BiDi page show` with a null navigation ID and `persisted` true. - "Unload a document": after `pagehide` fires, invoke `WebDriver BiDi page hide` with the document's salvageable state as `persisted`. The navigation ID is the during-loading navigation ID of `newDocument` when it is given, and null otherwise. The navigable's ongoing navigation cannot be used here: "apply the history step" always sets it to "traversal" before the document unloads. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Mozilla * Google - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * TODO: will add wpt PR for wdspec tests for `browsingContext.pageShow` and `browsingContext.pageHide` once we have some basic agreement on the webdriver-bidi PR at https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/1217 - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: TODO * Gecko: TODO * WebKit: TODO - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: … - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
